subject: [AMBER] Error: an illegal memory access was encountered launching kernel kNLSkinTest

messages.author: Hoang, Oanh Tu
messages.body:
Hello everyone,
I am running constant pH with amber and get an error when I start my production run:
Error: an illegal memory access was encountered launching kernel kNLSkinTest
Also after some steps, I get ***** or NaN values for the TEMP/Bond or Epot:
NSTEP =    20500   TIME(PS) =     441.000  TEMP(K) =      NaN  PRESS =     0.0
Etot   =            NaN  EKtot   =            NaN  EPtot      =   -607227.0534
BOND   =      1784.7189  ANGLE   =      5169.2871  DIHED      =      6831.9734
1-4 NB =      1975.0504  1-4 EEL =     20026.3094  VDWAALS    =     85381.2896
EELEC  =   -728395.6823  EHBOND  =         0.0000  RESTRAINT  =         0.0000
------------------------------------------------------------------------------
I used to run the constant pH MD with 13 titratable residues and it worked. Now I have 22 titratable residues and I get this error.
Does someone have an idea how I could fix this error? Could it be a hardware problem or is it a software problem?
Thank you in advance!
Best,
Hoang
